notes.title: MADWAY BIG Update 2.0 - MULTIPLAYER
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336854/c4d8ae1f352233531a44b339ed2dcca7c1a563d2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336854/4f3ee35db8ad950c05ff1d5bc5336e6e5f84c313.png[/img][/url]

[i]Hello everyone![/i]

[b]Update 2.0 is here![/b]

[h2]A new map (SandWay) is available.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336854/3e3437b0aa0fbe516c1d970430a272da482b514e.png[/img]

Changes :

- The leaderboard of the 1st map has been reset for the release of this update!
- Added a new solo/multiplayer map,
- Added a leaderboard for the new map,
- The multiplayer lobby is a live tiny map where you can custom your character,
- Controller gameplay (beta) has been added,
- Added additional translations (chinese, german, finnish),
- Props can now rotate on themselves,
- The new bumpers work in multiplayer,
- Wind turbines no longer lag for clients,
- Added several new characters,
- Added several new accessories and clothes.

Patches :

- Client rollbacks has been mitigated,
- The wind turbines are now functional and replicated,
- Some sounds and musics has been fixed,
- The splines (e.g: the boat) are now correctly cycling again after one travel,
- We can now go back to the main menu when we were in the multiplayer lobby creation,
- The menu music does not restart every time you navigate through the menus,
- Collisions of many props on the new map have all been fixed,
- Fixed a minor issue with online game creation,
- Fixed a bug that caused players to spawn under the map on startup,
- Blowers are now replicated,
- Rotating objects now work in multiplayer,
- Props were placed in several strategic places on the map, so that a player falling can catch up with its group,
- Multiplayer sessions now work with or without a password.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336854/c1586a0bf4f5cda4eaf38aa70ff0442313f0f83c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336854/0dc3715a3288db7c31ba8d8ed0570bba2d5ffab8.jpg[/img][/url]

Thanks to our two beta testers of the new map: [h3]Mickey92i & Gregsapp[/h3]


PS: We're aware that there are still a few issues to correct. We'll do our best to fix it!

[i]Issues that will be fixed soon : [/i]

-The leaderbord of the new map.. (if you want to validate your time for speedrun.com remember to register your games)
- Jump and superJump problem on the new bumpers.
- Problem if you join a multiplayer game and directly start a solo game.


Feel free to report your problems on our discord : https://discord.gg/4azJbFKaER

The MadWay Team.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336854/80e5b7fd5723c311b3b9cea26c956014e40cb3a0.png[/img]

We have been working hard since its release to address some minor but essential issues.

[h2]Update 1.1 :[/h2]

[h3]Fix :[/h3]

-Fixed an issue related to the loading screen after the cinematic.
-Fixed the leaderboard issue caused by old installed save folders.
-Fixed the airplane that was getting stuck.
-Fixed the framerate dependency on the acceleration of dynamic objects.

[h3]Additions :[/h3]

-Added a "Leaderboard" button in the main menu.
-Added the option to view rankings for previous versions of the game.
-Added objects to prevent players from getting stuck in the gold, aquarium, road, Rocket, and Russian quarter sections.
-Added several collectible objects.
-Added some objects to help save time.
-Added two new islands that players can grab onto in case of a fall.

[h3]Problems to be fixed very soon: :[/h3]

-The catfish spline does not restart in training mode.
-The transition from normal mode to training mode remains frozen.
-In training mode, the "Low poly" level does not reload.
-The airplane remains static in training mode.

[i]We are actively working to address these issues and provide you with an optimal gaming experience. Your support and feedback are crucial in helping us improve Mad Way![/i]
